headword: {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}

definitions.gloss: length of stay (in days); the number of days spent staying at a place, especially for travel or immigration purposes
definitions.explanation: length of stay (in days); the number of days spent staying at a place, especially for travel or immigration purposes

examples.japanese: {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}は{何日|なんにち}ですか。
examples.english: How many days is your stay?

examples.japanese: ビザなしの{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}は{最大|さいだい}{九十|きゅうじゅう}{日|にち}です。
examples.english: The maximum stay without a visa is ninety days.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}に{合|あ}わせて{荷物|にもつ}の{量|りょう}を{調整|ちょうせい}した。
examples.english: I adjusted the amount of luggage to match the length of my trip.

notes:
A practical compound used in travel, immigration, and hospitality contexts. Composed of {滞在|たいざい} (stay/sojourn) and {日数|にっすう} (number of days). This is one of the first things asked at immigration or when booking accommodations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}を{延長|えんちょう}する — to extend one's stay
- {最大|さいだい}{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう} — maximum length of stay
- {平均|へいきん}{滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう} — average length of stay
- {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう}を{超|こ}える — to exceed the allowed stay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{期間|きかん} — period of stay (formal/immigration term; measured in months or years)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}{日数|にっすう} — number of nights staying (hotel context; counted differently from {滞在|たいざい}{日数|にっすう})
- {滞在|たいざい}{期間|きかん} — period of stay (interchangeable but {期間|きかん} can also cover weeks/months)
